# TPC-DI VQ10

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcdi
```

> [TPC-DI](../../tpc-di.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DI queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  'Date Dimension Business Day Validation' AS validation_name,
  COUNT(*) AS total_dates,
  SUM(CASE WHEN HolidayFlag IS TRUE AND NOT DayOfWeekNum IN (1, 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS holiday_weekday_conflicts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DayOfWeekNum IN (1, 7) AND HolidayFlag IS FALSE THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS weekend_flag_errors,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN CalendarYearID <> CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(DateValue AS VARCHAR) FROM 1 FOR 4) AS INT)
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS year_mismatch_errors,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT CalendarQtrID BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid_quarter_errors,
  CASE
    WHEN (
      SUM(CASE WHEN HolidayFlag IS TRUE AND NOT DayOfWeekNum IN (1, 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN DayOfWeekNum IN (1, 7) AND HolidayFlag IS FALSE THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) + SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN CalendarYearID <> CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(DateValue AS VARCHAR) FROM 1 FOR 4) AS INT)
          THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END
      ) + SUM(CASE WHEN NOT CalendarQtrID BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    ) = 0
    THEN 'PASS'
    ELSE 'FAIL'
  END AS status
FROM DimDate
```
